# kind: # production is one of: on, off, auto, transient. This is the authoritative inventory.

name: AGXPROBE_HOLD
purpose: Keeps the AGX API probe alive for debugger attachment.

name: CA_DISABLE_SWAP_ICC
purpose: Required CoreAnimation compatibility; not a diagnostic.

name: CA_VSYNC_OFF
purpose: No working chroot vblank handoff; commits use the virtual completion path.

name: DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES
purpose: Launcher selects the matching thin libmachook slice.

name: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE
purpose: Official VS Code marker paired with VSCODE_RESOLVING_ENVIRONMENT; never set by a production plist.

name: IOSCLEAR_DRAW_MODE
purpose: Selects an iosclear reference draw experiment.

name: IOSCLEAR_EARLY_DELAY
purpose: Delays the early iosclear reference path.

name: IOSCLEAR_EARLY_HOLD
purpose: Holds the early iosclear reference path for a debugger.

name: IOSCLEAR_HEADLESS
purpose: Runs the iosclear reference without a visible window.

name: IOSCLEAR_HOLD
purpose: Keeps iosclear_ref alive for debugger attachment.

name: MACWS_IOS_KCMD_HOLD
purpose: Stops the native iOS AGX command encoder before commit for LLDB capture.

name: MACWS_IOS_KCMD_MODE
purpose: Selects the native iOS AGX command-encoder workload.

name: MACWS_IOS_MIP_TEXTURE_HOLD
purpose: Keeps the native iOS mipmapped-texture probe alive for LLDB inspection.

name: MACWS_IOS_MIP_TEXTURE_PROBE
purpose: Selects the native iOS mipmapped-texture descriptor workload.

name: MACWS_AGX_KEEP_PINNED_ALLOC
purpose: Absent selects the production iOS-native allocation redirect.

name: MACWS_AGX_KEEP_VALIDATE
purpose: Retains an old validation branch when explicitly set.

name: MACWS_AGX_NATIVE
purpose: Select the real iOS AGX driver path; mandatory production invariant.

name: MACWS_AGX_NATIVE_NON2D
purpose: Broad non-2D native texture allocation experiment.

name: MACWS_AGX_NATIVE_PLAIN
purpose: Variable is absent in production; absence enables the validated native-plain policy.

name: MACWS_APP_DISPLAY_SETTLE_MS
purpose: Bounded Terminal redraw settlement; not enabled for benchmarks.

name: MACWS_COEXIST_PACE_US
purpose: Production uses the documented /tmp/macws_coexist_pace_us file instead.

name: MACWS_HID_BYPASS
purpose: Broad HID compatibility hooks are not production-safe.

name: MACWS_JIT_MPROTECT_COMPAT
purpose: Chromium MAP_JIT/W^X compatibility without verbose trace.

name: MACWS_JIT_FAULT_WRITE_COMPAT
purpose: Page-granular V8 W^X adapter; only faulted 16-KiB writer pages become RW before RX restore.

name: MACWS_METAL_PROBE_DUMP_EVENT_IMP
purpose: Dumps the Metal event implementation pointer.

name: MACWS_METAL_PROBE_EVENT_ONLY
purpose: Restricts metal_source_probe to its event test.

name: MACWS_METAL_SOURCE_FORCE_IOS
purpose: Forces an iOS Metal source target.

name: MACWS_SUSPEND_AT_EXEC
purpose: SIGSTOP immediately after injection for LLDB attach.

name: MACWS_VNC_LOW_LATENCY_COMPRESSION
purpose: Clamp negotiated compression work factor to measured level 1.

name: MACWS_VNC_SHARE
purpose: Production enables the equivalent /tmp/macws_vnc_share session flag.

name: MACWS_XPC_DEBUG
purpose: XPC connection trace; no process enables it implicitly.

name: NSRunningFromLaunchd
purpose: Matches the real macOS Services daemon launch contract.

name: PATH
purpose: Explicit standard chroot executable search path.

name: PINPROBE_HOLD_BEFORE_PIN
purpose: Holds PinnedVAProbe before pinning for debugger attachment.

name: REDWIN_LOOP
purpose: Keeps the red-window rendering probe repainting.

name: VSCODE_RESOLVING_ENVIRONMENT
purpose: Exact official marker selecting the token-plus-JSON exec adapter and minimal constructor mode.

name: MallocScribble
purpose: Forbidden in every production launch plist.

name: --force-disable-user-env
purpose: Supported VS Code switch avoids the redundant main-service login-shell environment probe.

name: chat.agentHost.enabled
purpose: Avoid optional Copilot/Claude AgentHost processes unrelated to native-AGX WebGL measurement.

name: terminal.integrated.enablePersistentSessions
purpose: Avoid reviving stale benchmark-profile PTYs across isolated runs.

name: /tmp/macws_capture_final
purpose: One-shot validated post-client frame request; removed after acknowledgement.

name: /tmp/macws_kcmd_fix
purpose: Required direct native-AGX command ABI adapter.

name: /tmp/macws_kcmd_wrapped_fix
purpose: Required validated wrapped command ABI adapter.

name: /tmp/macws_real_swapend
purpose: Lets macOS contend for the physical panel in coexistence.

name: /tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics
purpose: Enables high-overhead recorders and per-frame/event logs.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_diag
purpose: Submit translation trace and raw dumps.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_native_all
purpose: Production owns this setting through OSXvnc environment.

name: /tmp/macws_coexist_pace_us
purpose: Production idle completion interval, currently 100000 us.

name: /tmp/macws_capture_done
purpose: PID and generation acknowledgement for the one-shot frame request.

name: /tmp/macws_graphics_ready
purpose: PID witness written after first clean producer completion.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_activity
purpose: Monotonic input timestamp selecting the 16.667 ms interactive interval.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_fb
purpose: Retina mmap pixel transport and publication sequence.

name: /tmp/ws_headless
purpose: Keeps the iPad panel owned by iOS.

name: /tmp/macws_fast_submit_error_%d_%u
purpose: Bounded fast-ring error dump directory; production cleanup removes all.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_error_%d_%u
purpose: Heap-ring error dump directory; production cleanup removes all.
